Saving projection results to CSV files

Source: R/wrappers.R
save_csv_all.Rd

Method for exporting all projection results to a set of .csv files. Each type of output data (e.g., population, fertility, mortality, migration, switching) is written to a separate file.

The export process can take up to an hour to complete, depending on dataset size—particularly for projections that include religious switching and migration, which generate large output files.

If switching or migration is disabled in the projection settings, the corresponding .csv files are skipped automatically.

Usage

save_csv_all(
  projection_object,
  objects = list("countries", "regions"),
  filenames_vector = c("projection_structure_data.csv", "projection_births_data.csv",
    "projection_asfr_data.csv", "projection_fertility_exposure_data.csv",
    "projection_fertility_differentials.csv", "projection_deaths_data.csv",
    "projection_emigration_data.csv", "projection_immigration_data.csv",
    "projection_switching_matrices.csv", "projection_switchers_data.csv"),
  folder,
  demographic_files = TRUE,
  switching_files,
  migration_files,
  order_by_name = FALSE,
  progress_bar = TRUE
)

Arguments

projection_object

Projection_object; a resolved (already projected) projection object.

objects

Character vector specifying which objects to export: `"countries"`, `"regions"`, or both. Default exports both where applicable — regions omit switching matrices and fertility differentials (character).

filenames_vector

Character vector of length 10 containing output file names, in order: structure data, births, ASFRs, fertility exposure, fertility differentials, deaths, emigration, immigration, switching matrices, switchers (character vector).

folder

Name of folder in which results should be saved. Defaults to projection_object's name (character).

demographic_files

Logical; if TRUE, saves structure data, fertility data, mortality data, ASFRs and women population data used in fertility calculations (default TRUE).

switching_files

Logical; if TRUE, saves switching matrices and switching data. Defaults to the projection's switching setting. Will error if TRUE when no switching was calculated.

migration_files

Logical; if TRUE, saves migration data. Defaults to the projection's migration setting (logical).

order_by_name

Logical; if TRUE, countries are ordered alphabetically by name. If FALSE, countries are ordered by ISO 3166-1 code (default FALSE).

progress_bar

Logical; whether to show a progress bar and ETA (default TRUE).

Value

Progress bar and time of execution.

See also

project to run the projection before exporting. save_plots_all to export visualisations instead of raw data. vignette("exporting-results") for a column-by-column description of every output file including example rows.

Examples

# Running a full projection is time-consuming.
# Wrapped in dontrun to avoid executing during documentation build.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
p_object <- create_projection_object(name = "test")
p_object$project()
p_object$save_csv_all()

p_object <- create_projection_object(name = "test")
project(projection_object = p_object)
save_csv_all(projection_object = p_object)
} # }
